title: jacobaea andrzejowskyi
intro: Jacobaea andrzejowskyi, commonly known as Andrzejowsky's hawk's beard or Jacobaea andrzejowskyi, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is a flowering plant native to Eastern Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Jacobaea andrzejowskyi include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
